description:
Round-2 codex finding 2 (High): verdict._finding (_project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/verdict.py ~336) HTML-escapes a path containing '<!--' (benchbox/query<!--bad.py becomes benchbox/query<!--bad.py) before protocol.judge (~463) compares it with the raw changed-path set, so the finding is excluded as out of scope and a High SHIP_WITH_FIXES finding ends as decision SHIP with the finding only under Not counted. Codex suggests keeping canonical paths for comparison and escaping only the rendered text.

DECISION GATE: reproduce first (a diff touching a file whose name contains '<!--' or '&' and a reviewer finding on it). Fix so the comparison uses the unescaped canonical path everywhere and escaping happens only at render/marker boundaries; check every other comparison of reviewer-supplied paths with changed paths. No change to what counts as in scope.

GUARDRAILS: never post a stand-in or any oracle comment; never rerun or dispatch the oracle; oracle verdict required on the PR (soundness path); no pre-registered digests; never weaken a gate; no skip/xfail; never bypass a hook by any route (no SKIP=, --no-verify, commit-tree); primary clone read-only (make worktree-create, absolute worktree paths, no git stash, no git add -A, identity Joe Harris); no CHANGELOG entry; no code comments/docstrings; always encoding utf-8; PR text for a reader who never saw the session; done = merged PR plus evidence.
